articles.summary: Record Revenues and Income from Operations; Application Filed to Commence Normal Course Issuer Bid; CFO Transition Plan Outlined for Next Fiscal Year WATERLOO, Ontario and ATLANTA, Georgia, December 3, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – The Descartes Systems Group Inc. (TSX:DSG) (Nasdaq:DSGX) announced its financial results for its fiscal 2026 third quarter (Q3FY26). All financial results referenced are in United States (US) currency and, unless otherwise indicated, are determined in accordance with US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
articles.title: Descartes Announces Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results
